title: Tofu Biryani Italian Fusion
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish combining the flavors of Vietnam with the spices of India, incorporating the umami taste of unique ingredients, and featuring pan-seared tofu. This fusion recipe results in a dish that is both familiar and exotic.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the block of tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the Vietnamese Fish Sauce and stir to combine.
Add the Biryani Basmati Rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Combine the cooked rice mixture with the tofu mixture and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
